case_name: Anitha T vs Kerala State Civil Supplies ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT.ANITHA T, AGED 51 YEARS, W/O. LATE C.SREENIVASAN
parties.respondent_defendant: 1 KERALA STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LIMITED, 2 TAHSILDAR, PERINTHALMANNA TALUK, MALAPPURAM DISTRICT-679 322, 3 STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY, DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE, SECRETARIAT, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695 001, 4 LEELA K., KOLOTHODI HOUSE, VADAKKANGARA P.O., MALAPPURAM DISTRICT-676 324

facts_of_case: The petitioner married C.Sreenivasan on 08.10.1983 as per the Hindu rites and customs. A daughter was born in the wedlock on 18.08.1984.

legal_principles.principle: A Hindu marriage solemnised under the Act can only be dissolved on any of the grounds specified under the Act.
legal_principles.held: Till the time a Hindu marriage is dissolved under the Act none of the spouses can contract second marriage.

legal_principles.principle: Conversion to Islam and marrying again would not, by itself, dissolve the Hindu marriage under the Act.
legal_principles.held: The second marriage by a convert would therefore be in violation of the Act.

outcome.final_order: The Court directed the 1st respondent to release and make payment of the terminal/pension benefits of her deceased husband, expeditiously.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
advising on alimony and maintenance in a divorce case
